Its ophthalmology institutions provide diagnosis treatment health care medical optometry glasses and other general ophthalmic medical services for patients with ophthalmic diseases in the areas of refractive surgery cataract ophthalmology fundus disease glaucoma strabismus and pediatric ophthalmology tear duct cornea disease orbital disease ocular trauma medical optometry and other general ophthalmology diagnosis and treatment items. The company was formerly known as Chengdu Bright Eye Hospital Group Co. Ltd. and changed its name to Bright Eye Hospital Group Co. Ltd. in June 2025. The company was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in Chengdu China.

Name: Xiamen Comfort Science&Technology Group Co. Ltd
Description: Xiamen Comfort Science&Technology Group Co. Ltd researches develops manufactures and sells health massage appliances in China and internationally. The company offers massage chairs and appliances; fresh air systems and air purifiers;and other products. It offers its products under the OGAWA FUJI IHOCO medisana BRI cozzia joypal EASEWELL and MICODE brand names. The company was founded in 1996 and is based in Xiamen China.

Name: Yamaichi Electronics Co.Ltd.
Description: Yamaichi Electronics Co.Ltd. manufactures and sells test connector and optical-related products in Japan and internationally. The company offers IC sockets for burn-in and test and probe cards as well as burn-in and board maintenance and repair services. It also provides connectors and production IC sockets including FPC/FFC card coaxial interface board board-to-board optical transceiver and board-to-cable connectors for various applications comprising cellular phones and smartphones game equipment multi-function and inkjet printer digital still/digital video cameras notebook /tablet PCs semiconductor equipment measuring instrument LCD television network and broadcast equipment automotive products industrial medical equipment and PV modules. The company offers flexible printed boards; and optical filters tunable laser light sources and optical modules. The company was incorporated in 1956 and is headquartered in Tokyo Japan.

Name: Shilpa Medicare Limited
Description: Shilpa Medicare Limited together with its subsidiaries manufactures and sells active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs) finished dosage formulations biosimilars and contract development and manufacturing organisation in India the United States Europe and internationally. The company offers various oncology and non-oncology APIs such as anastrozole acebrophylline ambroxol hydrochloride axitinib azacitidine abiraterone acetate bendamustine HCL monohydrate bicalutamide bortezomib busulphan cabazitaxel amorphous capecitabine clofarabine cyclophosphamide dasatinib decitabine dimethyl fumarate erlotinib HCL enzalutamide fingolimod hydrochloride gemcitabine HCl ibrutinib imatinib mesylate irinotecan HCl trihydrate lenalidomide lenvatinib mesylate letrozole and melphalan HCL. It also provides nifedipine oxaliplatin pazopanib pemetrexed disodium hemipentahydrate pemetrexed dipotassium nonahydrate pirfenidone pomalidomide sodium cholesteryl sulfate sorafenib tosylate sunitinib malate temozolomide teriflunomide thalidomide tranexamic and zoledronic acid phenylephrine citicholine palbocicilib nilotinib nintedanib praziquintol carmustine elthrombopag olamine abacavir sulphate tenofovir disproxyl fumarate API tenofovir alfanamide prucalopride succinate and varenicline tartrate. In addition the company offers intermediates; peptides; biopolymers; biologics; contract development and manufacturing services; and formulations such as tablets capsules liquid injections dry powder injectable products oral dissolving films transdermal patches. Further it is involved in the manufacture of specialized oncology formulations; and wind power generation activities. The company was formerly known as Shilpa Antibiotics Ltd and changed its name to Shilpa Medicare Limited in February 2003. Shilpa Medicare Limited was incorporated in 1987 and is based in Raichur India.

Name: Earth Corporation
Description: Earth Corporation engages in the manufacture marketing import and export of pharmaceutical products quasi-drugs medical tools and household products in Japan and internationally. It operates in two segments: Household Products Business and Comprehensive environmental hygiene Business. It also provides household insect control products gardening supplies daily necessities such as mouthwash denture-related products toothpaste products bath salts deodorant air fresheners etc. The company offers various insect rodent control cleaning and cleaning services to hospitals restaurants and office buildings. It markets its products under the Earth Red Earth No-mat Earth Jet Earth Mosquito Coil Saratect Gokiburi Hoi-Hoi Goki Jet Pro Black Cap Earth Mushi Yoke Net EX Mondahmin Bath Roman Onpo Pirepara Earth Sukki-ri! Earth Garden Polident Aquafresh and other brand names. Earth Corporation was founded in 1892 and is headquartered in Tokyo Japan.

Name: PKSHA Technology Inc.
Description: PKSHA Technology Inc. engages in the development of algorithmic solutions in Japan. The company offers PKSHA algorithm modules including voice recognition and synthesis natural language processing video/image recognition and synthesis and prediction/inference/optimization modules; and PKSHA Enterprise AI a software that improves accuracy using algorithms used in retail mobility and life lending and banking insurance learning medical and healthcare applications. It also provides PKSHA LLMS for various large scale language model related technologies; PKSHA Security a solution that deter fraud; PKSHA SCM provide various solutions that support distributors and retailers; and PKSHA MA/CRM a solution that process various types of customer data and provide marketing support solutions. In addition the company AI SaaS products comprising PKSHA Communication Cloud solves various issues in the customer support domain such as web inquires and contact center operations; PKSHA Workplace Cloud a solution that links various AI SaaS as a general contact point within the company to create internal DX through internal communication; PKSHA Chatbot a chat type dialogue engine that utilize natural language processing algorithm for the Japanese language; PKSHA Voicebot an accurate speech recognition and correction function; PKSHA FAQ a cloud based support solution for creating publishing and evaluating frequently asked questions and answers; PKSHA RPA a technology that automate usual work with RPA; PKSHA Speech Insight a tool that recognition speech; PKSHA AI Helpdesk for Microsoft Teams a help desk that automates the work and visualizes the log data of inquires exchanged on Microsoft Teams; and Shisei Karte a system that allow users to perform AI posture analysis and electronic medical record management with a tablet or a smart phone. It also provides consulting support services. PKSHA Technology Inc. was incorporated in 2012 and is based in Tokyo Japan.

Name: Cubic Sensor and Instrument Co.Ltd.
Description: Cubic Sensor and Instrument Co.Ltd. engages in the development production and sale of gas sensors and sensor solutions in China. It offers indoor air quality products such as CO2 sensor formaldehyde & VOC sensor IAQ controller and monitor integrated sensor module particulate matter sensor and optical particle counter; outdoor particulate matter sensing solution and oil mist sensor; ultrasonic oxygen sensor ultrasonic oxygen flow sensor TDLAS oxygen sensor DLCO gas sensor spirometer and NDIR ETCO2 sensor; automotive electronic products such as automotive air quality sensor automotive O2 and NO2 sensor and Li-battery thermal runway sensor; safety alarms which include refrigerant gas leakage monitoring sensor flammable gas safety monitoring sensor SF6 gas leakage monitoring sensor and toxic and hazardous gas safety monitoring sensor; smart metering solutions such as residential ultrasonic gas meter industrial ultrasonic gas meter residential ultrasonic gas flow sensor and commercial ultrasonic gas meter; and gas analyzer. The company offers its products in the fields of indoor and outdoor air quality monitoring automotive sensor health medical industry safety engine emission monitoring and smart metering. It also exports its products to approximately 80 countries and regions. The company was founded in 2003 and is based in Wuhan China.

Name: Shanghai Action Education Technology CO.LTD.
Description: Shanghai Action Education Technology CO.LTD. offers management training services to private entrepreneurs in China. The company provides management education services including management courses onboarding guidance annual consulting and learning tools. It also offers enterprise management consulting and training services as well as sells related books and audio-visual products. The company was founded in 2006 and is headquartered in Shanghai China.

Name: Sansec Technology Co. Ltd.
Description: Sansec Technology Co. Ltd. engages in the research development and production of commercial cryptographic products and solutions for internet information security in China. The company develops PCIe a cryptographic hardware device that enables data confidentiality integrity and other cryptographic functions through digital signature and data encryption; Cloud HSM that provides multiple authentication mechanisms based on PIN smart key and digital certificate; and General Purpose HSM a cryptographic device which offers security guarantee services for the development of social informatization. It also offers Financial HSM cryptographic equipment for cryptography-based protection for ICs such as social security cards for inter-bank transactions in the financial system; and Sansec HSM Cryptographic Module a cryptographic device used for financial e-government e-commerce and enterprise information systems. In addition it provides typical financial solutions big data security solutions and internet of vehicle solutions. The company was founded in 2008 and is based in Beijing China.

Name: Nan Juen International Co. Ltd.
Description: Nan Juen International Co. Ltd. together with its subsidiaries engages in the research development manufacturing and trading of steel ball guide rails in the United States Asia Europe Africa and internationally. It offers residential RV industrial appliance toolbox and server slides; office furniture; kitchen spaces; and loading products. The company was formerly known as Nan Juen Industrial Corporation and changed its name to Nan Juen International Co. Ltd. in September 1996. Nan Juen International Co. Ltd. was founded in 1977 and is headquartered in Taoyuan City Taiwan. Nan Juen International Co. Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Repon Industrial Corporation.

Name: Ningbo Solartron Technology Co.Ltd.
Description: Ningbo Solartron Technology Co.Ltd. researches develops produces and sells functional films in China. The company offers reflective optical base and other functional films as well as lithium-ion battery separator and solid electrolyte ion-conducting membrane. Its products are used in liquid crystal display power battery and energy storage solar photovoltaic and other fields. The company exports its products. Ningbo Solartron Technology Co.Ltd. was founded in 2010 and is headquartered in Ningbo China.

Name: Ningbo Exciton Technology Co. Ltd.
Description: Ningbo Exciton Technology Co. Ltd. engages in the research and development manufacture and sale of optical films and functional films in China. The company operates through four segments: Optoelectronics Photovoltaics Automotive and Batteries. It offers optical film products including diffusion film brightness and laminated enhancement film quantum dot film laminated silvered reflector 3D grating film and explosion-proof film. The company also offers photovoltaic backplane types such as T series coated and composite backplanes (TPC TPC-T TPC-BW) double-sided coated backplanes CPC CPC-B single-sided coated backplanes PC and gap reflective films for modules. In addition it provides solar backplane and window films. It offers its product in various display application fields comprising televisions monitors laptops tablets smart phones navigation systems and car displays. The company offers its product to new energy. Ningbo Exciton Technology Co. Ltd. was founded in 2007 and is based in Ningbo China.

Name: Fuji Kyuko Co. Ltd.
Description: Fuji Kyuko Co. Ltd. operates amusement parks hotels golf courses ski resorts outdoor and travel businesses and campgrounds in Japan. The company also engages in the transportation tourism distribution services real estate civil engineering and construction and information technology businesses. In addition it offers transportation services including Fujikyu railway and bus share-ride buses highway buses reserved buses etc. as well as real estate services such as building leasing condo/villa subdivision etc. The company was incorporated in 1926 and is headquartered in Shibuya-ku Japan.

Name: IFB Industries Limited
Description: IFB Industries Limited together with its subsidiaries manufactures and trades in home appliances in India and internationally. It operates through the Engineering Home Appliances Motor and Steel segments. Its products include laundry solution such as front and top load washing machine washer dryer refresher and clothes dryer; kitchen solutions including refrigerators microwave dishwasher and chimney as well as built in hob oven and appliances; air conditioners; stabilizer; accessories; modular kitchens; laundromatique; tumble dryers and dryers; ironers; and industrial laundry and dish care. The company also offers press tools and dies fine blanked components motors and cold rolled steel strips. The company was formerly known as Indian Fine Blanks Limited. IFB Industries Limited was incorporated in 1974 and is based in Kolkata India.

Name: Hindustan Foods Limited
Description: Hindustan Foods Limited engages in the business of contract manufacturing of fast moving consumer goods in India and internationally. The company offers breakfast cereals instant porridges rice crispies soups and soup powders spices and masala sauces dips pastes jams jellies preserves gravies cookies protein and granola bars chikkis and muesli; and hot and cold beverages and energy drink concentrates comprising carbonated soft drinks ice cream dessert tea coffee malt-based food glucose powder and dry mix powder. It also provides hair oil food gel cream and shampoo; talc shaving cream hand wash liquid and powder Eau De Toilette and after shave lotion; baby care products; body lotion moisturizer creams petroleum jelly shower gel face wash and scrub body scrub and wipes and dusting powder; and beauty and make-up products including lipstick lip colour lip crayon lip paint chap stick pressed/compact powders and eye make-up products. In addition the company offers leather and sports footwear and accessories that consists of men’s women’s and juniors’ footwear as well as slippers and flip-flops and uppers; fabric care products including liquid and powder detergent and fabric conditioners; home care products such as surface glass and toilet cleaners as well as liquid dish wash; pet food and hygiene products; and liquid vaporizers aerosols coils mosquito mats and activ cards. Further it provides vitamins minerals and nutraceuticals; nutrition products comprising super plant-based and organic foods; allopathic herbal and ayurvedic cosmeceutical and skin care products; foot care products such as medicated and non-medicated plaster; medicated lozenges; digestive remedies; gels and ointments; oral liquids; allopathic tablets; diabetic and high protein nutrition products; and dusting and cosmetic powder. The company was incorporated in 1984 and is headquartered in Mumbai India.

Name: MEGA P&C Advanced Materials (Shanghai) Company Limited
Description: MEGA P&C Advanced Materials (Shanghai) Company Limited produces and sells solid content water-based solvent free and special function coating products in China. The company offers  It serves customers in wind energy shipping container bridge construction and steel structure industries. The company was formerly known as Shanghai Mega Coatings Company Limited and changed its name to MEGA P&C Advanced Materials (Shanghai) Company Limited in 2020. MEGA P&C Advanced Materials (Shanghai) Company Limited was founded in 2002 and is based in Shanghai China.

Name: Changzhou Tenglong AutoPartsCo.Ltd.
Description: Changzhou Tenglong AutoPartsCo.Ltd. researches develops manufactures and sells auto parts in China and internationally. The company offers air-conditioning pipelines such as compressor suction and exhaust expansion valve inlet and outlet heater air conditioning and condenser connecting pipe assemblies; automotive heat exchange connecting tubes including heater and oil cooling inlet and outlet pipes evaporator imported tubes and inlet pipes; and automotive heat exchange systems comprising filling valves connectors pullovers covers flanges brackets and auto heat exchange accessories. It also provides automotive sensors consisting of diesel engine exhaust temperature water temperature and sunlight sensors; EGR cooling parts; auto precision aluminum tubes such as flat tubes intercooler tubes afflux tubes coaxial tubes and KOMO pipes; and reservoir package in master cylinder for automobile brake systems. Changzhou Tenglong AutoPartsCo.Ltd. was founded in 1997 and is based in Changzhou China.

Name: OKE Precision Cutting Tools Co. Ltd.
Description: OKE Precision Cutting Tools Co. Ltd. engages in the research development production and sale of CNC tool and cemented carbide products. The company offers CNC blades solid carbide tools carbide saw blades serrated blades solid carbide tools disc milling cutters and other cemented carbide cutting tools. The company was founded in 1996 and is headquartered in Zhuzhou China.

Name: Brazilian Rare Earths Limited
Description: Brazilian Rare Earths Limited focuses on the exploration of rare earth elements and other critical minerals in Brazil. It holds interests in the Monte Alto Pelé and Sulista project located in the Rocha da Rocha Province. Brazilian Rare Earths Limited was incorporated in 2021 and is based in Haymarket Australia.

Name: Shenzhen Yanmade Technology Inc.
Description: Shenzhen Yanmade Technology Inc. together with its subsidiaries engages in the research design development production and sale of automated and intelligent testing equipment in China and internationally. The company offers FPC automated testing equipment comprising dual-layer general-purpose multi-process and small-scale automated testing equipment as well as dual-station and six-station turntables and single-station bending fixtures; MEMS sensor testing equipment consisting of linear and single-station MEMS sensor testing and calibration equipment temperature and humidity sensor testing and calibration equipment IMU laboratory testing equipment and IMU test and calibration equipment; and automotive electronics/IC substrate testing equipment such as FPCA/CCS and roll-to-roll FPC flying probe testers and IC carrier board testing machines. It also provides RF testing equipment including RF multi-process line automation equipment RF single-process automatic loading and unloading testing equipment RF desktop robot loading and unloading equipment RF semi-automatic test equipment and RF three-station turntable testing equipment; and silicon photonics testing equipment such as coupled automated testing equipment and silicon photonics wafer testing equipment. In addition the company offers software trading and technical services. It exports its products. Shenzhen Yanmade Technology Inc. was founded in 2012 and is headquartered in Shenzhen China.

Name: Zhejiang Shuangyuan Technology Co. Ltd.
Description: Zhejiang Shuangyuan Technology Co. Ltd. engages in the research and development production and sale of automatic measurement and control and machine vision inspection systems in China and internationally. It offers new energy products including X&β-ray electrode surface density laser thickness and surface density and thickness online measurement and control systems; and coating width and alignment online inspection roller slitting and laser die-cutting CCD defect and size detection module welding quality inspection hardware die-cutting CCD defect and size detection and X-ray pole core online detection systems. The company also provides metal foil products such as metal foil areal density online detection copper foil surface defect inspection and aluminum foil surface defect online detection systems as well as on-line measurement and control systems for surface density of raw foil machine; medical hygiene material products comprising mask melting mask quality online detection and elimination and packet mask detection systems; and film products that consist of film and infrared thickness online measurement and control systems as well as on-line detection systems for film surface defects. In addition it offers non-woven products including non-woven fabric weight/moisture online measurement and control systems and on-line detection systems for surface defects of non-woven fabrics; and papermaking products such as paper quantitative/moisture online measurement and control steam condensate recovery and DCS control systems as well as online detection systems for paper defects. The company was founded in 2006 and is headquartered in Hangzhou China.

Name: People & Technology Inc.
Description: People & Technology Inc. offers coating calendaring slitting automation and other machineries. The company’s products include electrode MLCC OCA and PDLC film micro lens and protective film composite optical and window film silicone and adhesive release and prism film polaroid adhesive film hard and diffuser film back horizontal and vertical separator FCCL casting micro and ultra-filtration membrane and reverse osmosis membrane coating machines. It also provides electrode calendaring and polaroid film and FCCL laminating machines; electrode OCA and window film release and capacitor fil primary thermal paper label ceramic separator copper foil FCCL filter and non-woven fabric slitting machines; filter slitting machines; and LED die bonder CSP LED taping camera module tape attaching machines OIS VCM assembly line mandrel cutting wearable device tape attaching ink and laser marking machines and spreading machines. In addition the company offers electrode notching polaroid film rotary cutting and slitting film traverse and separator winding electrolytic copper foil depositing and post treatment electrolytic copper foil drum roll grinding copper foil cutting FCCL plating and inspection FCCL plazma treatment non-woven fabric traverse winder and auto-turret winding folding & rolling trimming and end cap assembly and filter inspection machines. Its products are used in lithium-ion battery separator copper foil film filter non-woven fabric paper etc. The company was founded in 2003 and is headquartered in Gumi-si South Korea.

Name: Changhong Huayi Compressor Co. Ltd.
Description: Changhong Huayi Compressor Co. Ltd. together with its subsidiaries engages in the research and development production and sale of household and commercial compressors under the HUAYI JIAXIPERA and CUBIGEL brands in China and internationally. The company develops and sells new energy vehicle air-conditioning compressor; and various refrigeration appliances including refrigerators freezers water dispensers ice makers and dehumidifiers. Its products are used in household refrigerators freezers supermarket refrigerated display cabinets fresh-keeping cabinets vending machines in airports schools office buildings commercial streets etc. The company was formerly known as Huayi Compressor Co. Ltd. and changed its name to Changhong Huayi Compressor Co. Ltd. in July 2018. Changhong Huayi Compressor Co. Ltd. was founded in 1996 and is based in Jingdezhen China.

Name: Hatton National Bank PLC
Description: Hatton National Bank PLC together with its subsidiaries provides banking and related services in Sri Lanka and internationally. It operates through eight segments: Corporate Retail SME Micro Treasury Insurance NBFI and Real Estate. The company offers savings current SMART FIT and foreign currency accounts; term deposits; personal home and educational loans; leasing; remittance; self-onboarding services; and debit credit and affinity/co-branded cards as well as digital mobile and internet banking services. It also provides issuance of bank guarantees and international trade services; spot transactions currency SWAP transactions treasury bills and bonds development bonds and repos and reverse repo; project financing solutions; and Islamic banking. In addition the company offers a range of products and services to SME clients such as term loans working capital financing project funding and distributor financing as well as operates import and export loan facilities; and development banking services to agro and micro finance sectors. Further it provides e-business solutions comprising of HNB PAYFAST an internet-based payment platform for payroll supplier payments dividends EPF/ETF contributions tax payments and others; transaction banking solutions; HNB Momo a mobile solution for merchants that accepts and pay through electronic payment card; merchant acquiring services; HNB payment gateway that facilitates online payment; and e-commerce solutions for micro small and medium businesses as well as microfinance loan scheme. Hatton National Bank PLC was founded in 1888 and is headquartered in Colombo Sri Lanka.

Name: Dynamatic Technologies Limited
Description: Dynamatic Technologies Limited manufactures and sells engineered products to the aerospace automotive and hydraulic industries in India the United States the United Kingdom rest of Europe Canada and internationally. The company offers gear pumps low noise pumps high-pressure pumps axial piston pumps low torque high-speed hydraulic motors plunger hand pumps hitch control valves rock shaft assemblies power steering valves and mobile control valves; and bespoke high-flow scavenging pumps lube oil pumps and water pumps. It also provides high-precision airframe and aerospace components; control surfaces such as wings ailerons wing flaps fuselages and doors; key flight-critical airframe structures such as flap track beams; and intricate iron castings. In addition the company offers geared motors; power steering units; construction equipment; and aluminium body hydraulic gear pumps and motors from low to very high-pressure ratings integrated gear and piston pump packages and heavy duty compact cast iron gear pumps and fan drive motors. Further it provides unmanned aerial vehicles; engineering services; metallurgical ferrous castings; medical products comprising HCV rapid antibody test viral RNA isolation and DNA extraction kits; and laboratory services such as testing and validation of products. The company was formerly known as Dynamatic Hydraulics Limited and changed its name to Dynamatic Technologies Limited in 1992. Dynamatic Technologies Limited was incorporated in 1973 and is based in Bengaluru India.

Name: Yinchuan Weili Transmission Technology Co. Ltd.
Description: Yinchuan Weili Transmission Technology Co. Ltd. engages in the research development production and sale of wind power gear boxes in China. It offers wind power yaw gear and pitch gear boxes for wind power turbines; rotary travel series and winch gear boxes for construction machineries; photothermal rotary drives; and electric drive assembly products. The company was founded in 2003 and is based in Yinchuan China.

Name: Kunshan TopA Intelligent Equipment Co.Ltd
Description: Kunshan TopA Intelligent Equipment Co.Ltd engages in the research development production and sale of intelligent equipment and digital factory system in China and internationally. The company’s product portfolio include machine vision alignment and detection; high-speed conveying and precise positioning; intelligent feeding intelligent control and informatization; and digitalization and other technologies. In addition it offers transportation and consumer electronics solutions. The company was founded in 2006 and is based in Kunshan China.

Name: Petrovietnam Camau Fertilizer Corporation
Description: Petrovietnam Camau Fertilizer Corporation engages in the production and trading of fertilizers nitrogen compounds and basic chemicals in Vietnam. The company also engages in wholesale and retail of fertilizers chemicals and bioactive products used for industrial/agricultural uses; agricultural activities and consultancy; warehousing storage loading and unloading services; research and development of natural science and engineering technical testing and analyzing; repair and maintenance of machinery and equipment; and website set-up and processing of rental data. In addition it is involved in the trading of products and materials plant varieties agriculture products and pesticides; production of non-alcoholic beverages and mineral water; real estate business with owned and leased property; supply and management of labor resources; and designing locations presenting and implementing advertising on websites application software for electronic devices and handheld devices as well as provision of fertilizing testing services. Further then company exports its products. The company was founded in 2011 and is headquartered in Cà Mau Vietnam. Petrovietnam Camau Fertilizer Corporation operates as a subsidiary of Vietnam Oil and Gas Group.
